chunks.id: Geography and Life/Geography and Life - General Descriptions.md::3422609303
chunks.file: Geography and Life/Geography and Life - General Descriptions.md
chunks.text: Eldenreach A massive, circular forest surrounds central Veloria, separating Arcallis, Veylan, and small villages from the outer edges of the continent. Magical beings and bloodlines survive deep within its hidden glades. Border villages live in constant fear of Church raids due to their proximity to arcane resources. The Church and central nations have carved paths to ease access to the continent's borders and extend their control, causing the destruction of precious forests and much magical life in the process. Most of the forest is still unexplored, rumored to shelter sorcerous beasts, wildblood families, and spirits that reflect magic’s true nature.

chunks.id: Geography and Life/Geography and Life - General Descriptions.md::08ab6f4e66
chunks.file: Geography and Life/Geography and Life - General Descriptions.md
chunks.text: The Spine Mountains A jagged range cutting from western cliffs to the northern cold. Rich mineral veins draw miners and excavators from multiple nations and the Church, while older civilizations persist within the tallest mountains, hiding metals and relics away from the rest of Veloria. Somewhere here lies the rumored Ashen Spire—magic’s last sanctuary—though all expeditions by enemies to locate it have failed.

chunks.id: Geography and Life/Geography and Life - General Descriptions.md::ec21b458d9
chunks.file: Geography and Life/Geography and Life - General Descriptions.md
chunks.text: General Life With magic in controlled cities already being rare and expensive and uncontrolled magic being only available in settlements farthest from the Church’s central influence, it goes without saying that the villages bound to controlled nations suffer the most from lack of healing and enchantment. Common workers and soldiers die from diseases untreated, leading to a rise in local disdain for Church policies, but not enough power to ever confront it. Travel between central areas is expedient thanks to developed roads, but checkpoints and tolls have increased.

chunks.id: Geography and Life/Geography and Life - General Descriptions.md::ca5d566611
chunks.file: Geography and Life/Geography and Life - General Descriptions.md
chunks.text: Beyond Veloria Foreign continents and cultures exist just across the seas—some hostile, others curious—but few outsiders understand Veloria’s fear of magic or the grip of the Church. Many adventurers come to Veloria in search of work, glory, or deeper motives, and find Veloria both profitable and perilous - especially if they end up on the wrong side of the Church. Most learn quickly to hide anything that glows.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md::280d1eaf61
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md
chunks.text: The largest and strongest nation. Arcallis is deeply tied with the Church and serves as the primary military enforcement of Purity across Veloria, commanding constant patrols and inspections to maintain its influence and secure the Church’s ideals. A strong monarchy promotes the face of order and covers the Kingdom’s potential wrongdoings, securing the centralization of the continent's power and popularity under the Church.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md::2ca278879b
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md
chunks.text: The capital city of Dawncrest is the political heart of Church influence, rising in white stone and gold spires with lamps fueled by sacred oils. Every district is watched by Church wardens, and even the air feels judged. Other smaller Arcallan cities are orderly but bleak - military drills and recruitment in every square, sermon bells replacing joy.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md::9cf71c767a
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md
chunks.text: The Republic of Veylan - The Republic of Veylan - General Description A wealthy center of trade and innovation. Publicly secular but discreetly reliant on Church favor. The rich upper class exchange favors within the Church, while the average citizen lives barely above poverty and must fend for themselves through any means. Lacking a formal military, many Veylani citizens enlist with Arcallis for survival and opportunity. In the capital city of Veyloris, canals and trade houses define the bustling center of commerce. Magic here is a luxury of the elite, locked behind noble gates or auctioned in private under the protection of brides and allegiances.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md::ea486efadc
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md
chunks.text: The Freeholds of Kessra The diverse collection of independent clans located in the Eastern highlands. Clan loyalty supersedes religion. Magic is still feared but sometimes sheltered if it benefits the clan. The clans see mostly eye to eye and are officially neutral in Church matters, but tension rises as Purity Laws creep closer to uncovering their use of magic and intervening with their ways of living. The clans meet in Stonehall, a massive fort of connected longhouses surrounding a sky-piercing monolith, said to contain ancient power. The clans have become more united in order to protect their independence.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md::baf60401af
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md
chunks.text: The Duskport Confederacy Industrial port cities along the southern coast. A place of masked intentions: trade booms, smuggling thrives, and foreign influence seeps into streets crowded with innovations of factories and steam. Magic survives here, far from Church control and supported by accepting foreigners, but is more often used for personal gain than true good. The largest city of Duskport is a maze of industrial docks, dense housing, and foggy streets. Foreign ships offload inventions, people, and philosophies the Church would sometimes rather see burned.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md::824d20d1b9
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/Nations of Veloria - Letter's General Descriptions.md
chunks.text: The Old North A harsh, frozen frontier resisting Church domination. Ancient magical traditions live on in secrecy within the northern clans. Militarily hardened, rumored to be the only nation that could withstand a full Church crusade due to their environmental advantage and sheer numbers. Secret paths through the constant blizzards hide an unknown world from the vision of the church.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Duskport Confederacy/The Duskport Confederacy - General Description.md::c6a5d42ad0
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Duskport Confederacy/The Duskport Confederacy - General Description.md
chunks.text: The Duskport Confederacy is a loose alliance of coastal city-states bound not by loyalty, but by fear of irrelevance. Positioned along Veloria’s southern shore, it is the beating heart of maritime trade — a place where foreign gold flows thicker than clean water, and every dock sells secrets more readily than fish. Fog rolls in from the sea, giving cover to smugglers, cutthroats, and innovators alike. The Church of the Dawn maintains minimal presence here given how far out of reach they are. Magic is by no means celebrated, but in Duskport, if it puts food on tables, keeps the factories running, and makes the rich merchants an extra buck, no Porter will look too closely. Within these maze-like streets, power is measured in crew membership, favors, and how many people would bleed before letting you drown.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Duskport Confederacy/The Duskport Confederacy - General Description.md::b216c9b528
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Duskport Confederacy/The Duskport Confederacy - General Description.md
chunks.text: The city of Duskport is the Confederacy’s crown jewel — a sprawling harbor city built on pilings and dark ambition. Oil-slick canals cut between stacked tenements, while towering factories cough steam into the ever-present fog. Barges from foreign lands crowd the ports, unloading contraband, ideas, and trouble under the watchful eyes of greedy street crews looking to control another piece of property. Church banners hang over the central plaza, but their sermons fade against the clatter of forges and the quiet deals made in shadowed taverns. Here, justice is purchased, and the only real law is that the rich don’t fall — and the poor don’t swim too close to the edge. Duskport is where fortunes are minted, reputations are shattered, and the Confederacy whispers its future into being.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::1b3d95778b
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: An artsy city of canals and glass towers. Bridges arch over waterways glowing with lanterns fueled by imported oil. Gilded gondolas carry merchants and envoys through mirrored corridors of water, where the lights never seem to go out — except in the slums.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::c293630352
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: The air smells of perfume, hot iron, and stagnant water. Elegant spires cast their reflections over shanties built from discarded cargo crates.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::32e1509848
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: By day, the city glitters like a promise. By night, its reflections tremble — because no light here is truly pure.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::849567a9a2
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: The Ascendant Ring — the innermost circle around the Veylani Assembly. Bureaucrats, magnates, and Church envoys dwell here behind marble façades and glass gardens. You can’t enter without a sponsor’s crest or a signed permit. The canals are patrolled by private guards

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::a26625c3af
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: The Artisan Quarter — workshops, artificers, and innovators crowd the mid-level bridges. The “Innovation Guild” licenses inventions and quietly censors anything that challenges Church-sanctioned science. Failed experiments and broken constructs are dumped into the lower waterways.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::9c706e949e
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: The Gilded Market — a floating bazaar that moves weekly, hosted on chained barges. Here, alchemical components are sold under noble patrons’ protection. Exotic goods from Duskport, Kessra, and foreign lands flow through auctions every dusk.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::c100e22b32
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: The Floodways — the slum labyrinth under the main city, where the poorest live in damp tenements or drift-houses tied to bridge pylons. Law exists only where coin demands it. Illegal prize fights, drug dens, and smuggling tunnels thrive here. The Church pretends this district doesn’t exist — until it needs scapegoats.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::fba09a6228
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: The canals never freeze, thanks to a contract with the Church to receive the Dawn's blessing of warmth.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::08560c48e5
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: Constant sunny days turn the streets reflective and disguise the city’s rot.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::688d4f933a
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: People are warm and frequent the market areas, but only the higher classes live in the central city. Most middle class civilians live in the outer rings or nearby small towns.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::5bed6e1585
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: The Veylani Mindset: “If you can afford morality, you’ve earned it.”

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::b519ae843d
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: The Elite — polished, eloquent, and utterly transactional. They host masquerades where alliances are made in coded compliments. Many have secondary estates in Arcallis or pay for Church “blessings” that protect their patents and lineages.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::484b4a1229
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: The Working Class — artisans, scribes, couriers, and factory hands. They romanticize innovation, dreaming that one invention could lift them to fame. But the system ensures their ideas are bought cheap and rebranded by their patrons.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::9cb37550b4
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: The Forgotten — Children of debtors, gamblers, and addicts. They work the Floodways, run packages through dangerous channels, and sell their fists, bodies, or magic to survive.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md::c4615034fb
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/City of Veyloris/City of Veyloris - Description.md
chunks.text: Even the poor speak with the cadence of merchants — every word is a bargain.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/The Republic of Veylan - General Description.md::51ab00241c
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/The Republic of Veylan - General Description.md
chunks.text: Veylan is the continent’s glittering lie — a republic in name, an oligarchy in truth. It prides itself on being the beating heart of trade, invention, and art — a land where intellect triumphs over faith. But behind that façade, every invention is patented through bribery, every policy dictated by profit, and every innovation financed by the same noble families that whisper prayers to the Church when it suits them.

chunks.id: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/The Republic of Veylan - General Description.md::9c54d7cdd0
chunks.file: Nations of Veloria/The Republic of Veylan/The Republic of Veylan - General Description.md
chunks.text: It’s a place where genius is currency, and poverty is seen as a moral failing. For those born in its shadows, like Dönar, survival is the only ideology left.
